units: <cite ref="Taanit 3b:4">Taan. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>לא אמר מוריד הַגָּ׳</he> if he failed to insert in the second benediction (v. <cite ref="C00062"><he>גְּבוּרָה</he></cite>) ‘Who sendeth rain’.—Pl. <he>גְּשָׁמִים</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 1:1">Taan. I, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>גבורות ג׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C00062"><he>גְּבוּרָה</he></cite>.
Ib. 2 שואלין את הג׳ we insert the petition for rain in the ninth benediction, v. שַׁאֲלָה.—ימות הג׳ rainy season, autumn and winter.
Toh. VI, 7, v. בִּקְעָה; a. v. fr.—שְׂדֵה גְ׳ (or sub. שדה) a field naturally watered by rain, opp. שלחין.
Bekh. VI, 3 של ג׳ from fields with natural irrigation; cmp. בַּעַל. [In later Hebr. literature גֶּשֶׁם substance, v. next w.].
